meta.source: Apple homepage — live visual audit and supplied Apple.xml snapshot

colorSystem.observation: Surfaces stay neutral; color is concentrated in product imagery and primary actions.

typography.hierarchy: Large, compact product headings with restrained supporting copy.
typography.doNotCopy: SF Pro is proprietary and is not used in the portfolio.

layout.pattern: Full-width product stages with tightly constrained text blocks and strong vertical rhythm.

spacing.principle: Large negative space around one primary idea per section.

navigation.desktop: Fixed, compact global bar; live audit measured 44px height.
navigation.mobile: Condensed icon-led navigation with large menu surface.

hero.pattern: One dominant headline, one supporting line and a very small CTA set.

buttons.pattern: Primary filled action paired with a quieter secondary action; subtle color transition.

cards.pattern: Large visual fields rather than many small cards.

imageTreatment.pattern: Images are allowed to carry scale while text remains concise.

borders.pattern: Hairlines and section separation are preferred to heavy containers.

motion.observedTransition: Color transitions around 320ms with a controlled cubic-bezier curve.
motion.principle: Motion clarifies state changes and content entry.

scrollBehavior.pattern: Long editorial scroll with clear product-stage transitions.

responsiveBehavior.pattern: Headline scale and composition change deliberately for mobile; imagery remains the focal point.

interactionStates.pattern: Hover and focus changes are low-amplitude and legible.

accessibilityPatterns.pattern: Semantic navigation labels, visible text actions and high neutral contrast.

footer.pattern: Dense legal/navigation footer is visually subordinated to main content.

takeaways: Give every section one clear focal point.
Use scale and whitespace before decoration.
Keep the action set deliberately small.
Use subtle transitions with consistent timing.
